[*] North Korea added (level only)
[*] Timer/Score/Deaths toggle added to GUI (left thumbstick button)
[*] Ice is easier to break (Antarctica)
[*] Bots take slightly longer to shoot lasers (Antarctica)
[*] Recluse now shoots consistently in Act 2
[*] General Optimization
[/list]
